title: Epstein circle's gravity interest as an electrogravitics/UFO quest

tellings.quote: Therefore, I suspect that the interest in gravity is an interest in electrogravitics and you know the Townson Brown effect and basically it's all part of the UFO phenomenon that they're trying to crack.

plain: The interest in gravity research shown by the circle around the financier Jeffrey Epstein and his associate Ghislaine Maxwell may really have been a hunt for electrogravitics, the idea that electric fields can push against gravity, linked to the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown. The philosopher Jason Jorjani gives this as his own suspicion, drawn from a piece he wrote on his Substack newsletter about Maxwell. He says it is "all part of the UFO phenomenon that they're trying to crack", which would mean wealthy private players were chasing how UFOs fly.
